title: Maintenance Worker — National Park Service
summary: You will serve as a Maintenance Worker within the Department of the Interior, National Park Service, Pacific West, Maintenance Division, Wisdom, Montana or Walla Walla, Washington or Lapwai, Idaho. $29–$34 per hour
